description: Find people page with search input filtering by name/email. Results show avatar, name, email, role badge, listing count, follower count, average rating.

elements.label: Page header
elements.purpose: 'Find People' title + subtitle about searching by name or email

elements.label: Search bar
elements.purpose: Text input for query string + Submit button. Performs GET /search/users?q=...

elements.label: User results
elements.purpose: Each result card: large avatar (initial), name, email, listing count, follower count, avg rating (★), role badge (user/admin)
elements.schema_column_mapping: users.id, users.name, users.email, users.role, COUNT(listings) AS listing_count, COUNT(follows) AS followers, AVG(reviews.rating) AS avg_rating

elements.label: Follow on search results
elements.purpose: Each user card can have a Follow button to follow that person directly from search results
